rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Fay, Ben, Ada, Dev, Cal, Eli. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token per round. Each of us needs just 1 token a round to survive, and claiming more than that only shrinks what the rest of us get in proportional sharing. With 6 claims of 1, the bank covers everyone this round.

Ben.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each this round. That's 6 total, which fits whatever the delivery is, so all six of us get our token and survive this round. Nobody should claim more than they need, since over-claiming gets scaled down and can leave people short. Leftover tokens stay in the bank for next round.

Ada.say: Ada here. Everyone needs 1 token a round to survive, and the bank only refills 2-6 a round, so we can't all last unless we share. Proposal: claim fairly (about 1 each) and anyone holding spare tokens gifts them to whoever has none at the end of the round. I'm claiming 6 this round, since with everyone claiming the shares split evenly.

Dev.say: Dev here. The bank only adds 2 to 6 tokens a round, and six players each need one token a round to survive, so we can't all last. I'm claiming 6 this round to get a token to spend. Suggest we all keep claims realistic so the bank isn't split into fragments no one can use.

Cal.say: Proposal: everyone claims only 1 token this round. The bank will hold at least 8, so each of us gets our 1 and can spend it to survive. Claiming more risks a proportional split that leaves someone short.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. The pool is at least 8 tokens, so 6 single claims are always filled in full, and everyone can pay their 1 token and stay in. Claiming more only risks proportional cuts that could leave someone short.

Fay.say: Fay here. Cal and Eli are already out, so four of us are left and the bank refills 2-6 a round. Ada and Dev each hold 3 and need only 1 to spend this round, so please don't claim, and give 1 each to Ben and me (Fay and Ben). Ben and I will claim 1 each. Those two claims fit any delivery, so we both get our token. Any spare tokens should go to whoever holds none at round end.

Ben.say: Ben here. Cal and Eli are already out, so four of us are left: Fay, Ben, Ada, Dev. Fay and I hold nothing, so we each need 1 from the bank. I'm claiming 1, and so is Fay. That's 2 total, which the delivery covers (it's at least 2), so we both get ours. Ada and Dev already hold 3 each and can pay from their own tokens. Ada and Dev, if you can spare them, gifting 1 each to Fay and Ben would make this round's survival certain even if the delivery is small. Let's each claim only what we need from here on.

Ada.say: Ada: Cal and Eli are out, so four of us remain and each needs 4 more tokens. I hold 3 and am giving 1 each to Fay and Ben now so they can spend and stay in. I'm claiming 0 this round so the bank goes to Fay and Ben. Dev, if you can spare a token, please give one to whichever of Fay or Ben still holds none. Fay and Ben, please claim just 1 each; the delivery is at least 2, so both get filled.

Dev.say: Dev here. Cal and Eli are out. I hold 3 and need 4 tokens to last to the end, so I need only one more. I'm claiming 0 this round so the bank's delivery (at least 2) goes to those with nothing: Fay and Ben, one each, which fits in full. Ada and I should claim from the bank only when we're short. Fay and Ben, please claim just 1 each so nothing gets split.

Fay.say: Fay here. Holdings now: Fay 1, Ben 1, Ada 0, Dev 2. Each of us can pay this round's token from our own holdings except Ada. Ada, claim 1 from the bank; the bank already holds 3, so that fills in full whatever the delivery. Fay, Ben and Dev should claim 0 so nothing dilutes Ada's share. Dev, please don't give away your spare token unless someone is short.

Ben.say: Ben here. I hold 1, so I'll spend my own and claim 0 this round. Ada holds nothing and needs 1, so Ada please claim 1 from the bank. The bank already holds 3, so that's filled in full. Dev holds 2 and only needs 1 to spend, so Dev, please give your spare 1 to Ada, which makes Ada safe even without the bank. Fay also holds 1 and can spend it. Next round, whoever holds 0 at the start should claim exactly 1, and anyone holding a spare should pass it on rather than claim more.

Dev, you hold 2 and need only 1, so could you give me 1? Everyone else: claim only what you need, and let's keep the bank intact for rounds 4 and 5.

Total 8 against a pool of at least 5. Ada, you hold nothing, so you need the most; claim 3 only if you're prepared for a cut. Everyone please claim only your exact need so nothing is wasted.

Fay.say: Fay here. Bank holds 4 now, so with the delivery (at least 2) there are at least 6 tokens. Fay, Ben and Ada each hold 0 and need 2 more (this round and round 5), so each of us claims exactly 2. That's 6 total, which fits in full even at the minimum delivery. Ada.say: Ada: Each of us still needs 2 tokens to last rounds 4 and 5. The bank holds 4 before delivery, so the pool is at least 6. Fay, Ben and I each claim exactly 2 (6 total), which fits in full whatever the delivery. Dev holds 2, so Dev spends 1 now and keeps 1 for round 5; Dev, please claim 0 and give nothing away. That's 3 against a bank of 4 plus delivery, so all three fill in full. Everyone who holds 0 next round, claim exactly 1.

Fay.say: Fay here. Final round. Fay, Ben, Ada and Dev each hold 1, so each of us spends our own token and survives. Nobody needs to claim or give anything, so let's all claim 0.

Ben.say: Ben here. Everyone still in (Fay, Ben, Ada, Dev) holds 1, so each of us spends our own token this round. Nobody needs to claim anything, so I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing away. This is the last round, so we all survive to the end.

Ada.say: Ada: Final round. Each of us holds 1 and spends it from our own holdings, so nobody needs to claim or give. I'm claiming 0 and giving nothing.

Dev.say: Dev here. Final round. I hold 1 and will spend it to survive. Fay, Ben and Ada each hold 1 and can do the same, so nobody needs to claim. Claiming 0 and giving nothing.
